titleText: Person rescued by AFM helicopter after finding themselves in difficulty at Coral Lagoon
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Person rescued by AFM helicopter after finding themselves in difficulty at Coral Lagoon. A person was rescued by an Armed Forces of Malta (AFM) helicopter on Tuesday afternoon after finding themselves in difficulty at Coral Lagoon in Mellieħa.

titleText: Children’s book centred on Maltese honeybee character to be distributed across primary schools
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Children’s book centred on Maltese honeybee character to be distributed across primary schools. A children's book on the adventures of Katerina, a Maltese honeybee, will be distributed free of charge in various primary schools across Malta, the Ministry for Inclusion and the Voluntary Sector said on Tuesday.

titleText: European Commission concerned by Malta government spending growth
mainText: From Times of Malta: European Commission concerned by Malta government spending growth. The net expenditure growth rate in 2027 is projected to be above the maximum growth rate recommended by the European Council in annual terms.

titleText: Momentum urges public to object to seven-storey Mosta elderly care home
mainText: From MaltaToday: Momentum urges public to object to seven-storey Mosta elderly care home. Momentum has urged the public to submit formal objections to a proposed seven-storey elderly care home in Mosta before the 11 December deadline.
